nodes.label: Random Forest Feature Importance for SyncD
nodes.description: Random Forest feature importance (n=447) for predicting SyncD. Top features: mfcc_3_std (most important, ~0.10), mfcc_4_std, mfcc_11_mean, onset_std. MFCC standard deviations dominate top ranks, suggesting feature variability matters more than means.

metadata.finding: MFCC variability (especially lower-order coefficients) and onset dynamics are most predictive of SyncD; standard deviations matter more than means
